annotations.title: Set up e-mail at a domain

description: Set the MX, SPF and verification records of an e-mail provider at a domain: google, microsoft (needs mx_host), icloud or zoho. The provider shows the verification value in its admin area. Replaces mail records KENJTEC set before. Ask the user first: mail delivery changes.

provider.description: The mail provider whose records should be set up.
